craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 19. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Single liṅga and the rest as place, where the self is pleased; the maṇḍala three-trident-lotus-wheel, which in mantra-maṇḍala.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekaliṅgādi ca sthānaṃ yatrātmā saṃprasīdati maṇḍalaṃ tritriśūlābjacakraṃ yanmantramaṇḍale
